unmatched_reported.note: The grace-window lookup returns the account's newest live token rather than this token's successor; the stated two-device trigger is concrete.
Login lower-cases the email but registration stores the raw case, so a mixed-case registration cannot log in.

The registerAccount existing-user branch skips bcrypt and the insert, which creates a timing-based enumeration on that endpoint.
Map.of with null optional fields throws NPE, which turns the rejection into a 500.

Coach/Player use a bare save() with a deferred insert, so the DataIntegrityViolation catch is dead and the conflict surfaces at commit.
save() on a managed entity defers the version check until commit, so the optimistic-lock catch never fires.
The parent OTP verify allows 10 attempts per OTP against 5 for its sibling services, which doubles the guess budget.
